title: Cloudflare Workers KV legacy routes
description: Cloudflare documents retirement of the legacy Workers KV namespace route and directs callers to the storage/kv namespace route.
oldBehavior: The application addresses the legacy Workers KV namespace route.
newBehavior: The application addresses the documented storage/kv namespace route.
migrationInstructions: Replace a direct literal /accounts/{account_id}/workers/namespaces/ path with /accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces/.
Review authentication, aliases, dynamic URL construction, and endpoint semantics before applying the change.

evidenceSources.summary: Official Cloudflare documentation records the legacy Workers KV namespace route and the storage/kv route family used for the replacement.

review.notes: Reviewed against the official Cloudflare route documentation; executable transformation is limited to direct string literals containing the documented route prefix.

assumptions: The source establishes the route-family migration but not dynamic URL construction or SDK wrapper behavior.
Only direct string literals are eligible for a deterministic proposal.
Every generated patch remains subject to verification and human approval.
